Hi, thanks for meeting today.

You questioned the 60% adoption rate. Most people treat the demand model like scripture—you stress-tested it. That's not just analysis, that's judgment. And you earned the recommendation: 80% active, 13 pints per week, texture issues tracked back to co-packer inconsistency. You connected quality to retention before I had to drag it out of you.

The one thing I'll hold you to: getting weekly active rate, pints per account, and qualitative texture feedback into a rhythm you can actually act on. If that slips under 70% in week three, I want you seeing it immediately—not in a monthly report.

You've got conviction and you did the work to back it. I'm greenlighting the plant.

I'll check back in with you at the six-month mark—I want to see how these numbers actually play out. In the meantime, you've got my full backing.

Zena

P.S. — I'll send you a six-month update on how this all played out.

When adoption landed at 52% (not 60%), the team caught it in week six, tightened targeting, and stabilized supply. Carlos is energized; demand is now compounding.
